name: 06_config_empty_env_var_must_not_mask_file
why: A wrapper script that does `export ANHUR_API_KEY=` (or a systemd unit with an empty Environment=) leaves the variable SET but empty. An empty string is not a value: it must not shadow a perfectly good key sitting in the env file. This is the same shape as the incident - configuration present, plugin inert - and it is the one case where the two implementations were found to disagree.

not_compared.vars_loaded: Same documented difference as scenario 05: Go counts injected variables, Python counts parsed variables. Diagnostic only.

on_failure: A plugin reporting api_key_source=missing here is DISABLED by an empty environment variable while a valid key sits in its own env file. Python already treats empty as absent (config.py _first_non_empty). Go does not: core/envfile.go skips the file value when os.LookupEnv reports the variable as SET, and an empty string is set. Note that Go is inconsistent with ITSELF here - core.go envOr() (used for ANHUR_URL, ANHUR_CONTAINER, ANHUR_ARCHIVE_DIR) already falls back when the variable is empty, so only the API key behaves this way. Fix (Go, core/envfile.go loadEnvFileInto): skip the file value only when the existing variable is non-empty, i.e. `if existingValue, alreadySet := os.LookupEnv(name); alreadySet && strings.TrimSpace(existingValue) != ""`. Then re-run this harness: the scenario turns green with no other change.
